smartphone.composition: Glass/metal/plastic casing, LCD or OLED display, printed circuit board (PCB), lithium-ion battery, copper wiring, small speakers/microphones and camera modules.
smartphone.verify_hint: Confirm it is a phone, not a laptop or tablet, before using this guidance.

reusable.name: Display (LCD/OLED)
reusable.note: Often refurbishable for repair markets; otherwise recyclable.

reusable.name: Camera module
reusable.note: Working modules can be salvaged for repair or reuse.

reusable.name: Circuit board metals
reusable.note: Recoverable copper, gold and silver traces.

reusable.name: Casing (metal/plastic)
reusable.note: Aluminium and plastic can be separated and recycled.

reusable.name: Speakers / microphones
reusable.note: Small parts reusable in refurbishing.

harmful.name: Lithium-ion battery
harmful.risk: Fire or explosion risk if punctured, bent or crushed (thermal runaway).
harmful.handling: Do not puncture or bend. Remove carefully, tape the terminals, store separately in a fire-safe container.

harmful.name: Leaded solder on PCB
harmful.risk: Lead exposure if the board is burned, ground or crushed without protection.
harmful.handling: Do not burn or grind. Wear gloves and send boards to a certified e-waste recycler.

harmful.name: Older CCFL backlights (pre-~2012 models)
harmful.risk: Trace mercury exposure if the display is shattered.
harmful.handling: Avoid breaking the screen; treat as hazardous waste if the model is old.

laptop.composition: Plastic/magnesium/aluminium casing, LCD panel (CCFL- or LED-backlit), lithium-ion battery pack, motherboard (PCB) with leaded or lead-free solder, capacitors, RAM, SSD/HDD, fan and heat sink, keyboard, charger and copper wiring.
laptop.verify_hint: Confirm it is a laptop, not a large phone or tablet, before using this guidance.

reusable.name: RAM and SSD/HDD
reusable.note: Commonly reusable. Wipe or destroy drives first - they hold personal data.

reusable.name: Display panel
reusable.note: Refurbishable for repair markets.

reusable.name: Keyboard, hinges, charger
reusable.note: Reusable as spare parts.

reusable.name: Heat sink / fan (copper, aluminium)
reusable.note: Recyclable metals.

reusable.name: Motherboard metals
reusable.note: Recoverable copper, gold and silver.

harmful.name: Lithium-ion battery pack
harmful.risk: Fire risk if punctured, crushed or shorted. Swelling means it is already unstable.
harmful.handling: Disconnect and remove the pack first. Never pry it with metal tools. Check for swelling; store separately.

harmful.name: Leaded solder on motherboard
harmful.risk: Lead exposure if burned, ground or heated.
harmful.handling: Do not burn or desolder without ventilation and protection. Send boards to a certified recycler.

harmful.name: Mercury backlight (older CCFL screens)
harmful.risk: Mercury vapour if the lamp breaks.
harmful.handling: Do not break the display. Treat older screens as hazardous waste.

harmful.name: Capacitors and brominated flame-retardant plastics
harmful.risk: Capacitors can leak or hold charge; some plastics release toxic fumes if burned.
harmful.handling: Never burn casings. Handle with gloves.

crt.composition: Evacuated glass tube (leaded funnel and front panel glass), phosphor coating, electron gun, high-voltage circuitry, large capacitors, PCBs with leaded solder, plastic casing with copper wiring.
crt.verify_hint: Check for a deep, bulky back and curved glass. A thin screen is a flat panel, not a CRT.

reusable.name: Copper yoke and wiring
reusable.note: Recoverable copper.

reusable.name: Casing and steel frame
reusable.note: Plastic and steel can be recycled once the tube is removed.

reusable.name: Circuit boards
reusable.note: Recoverable metals via a certified recycler.

harmful.name: Vacuum glass tube (implosion risk)
harmful.risk: A cracked tube can implode and throw glass shards.
harmful.handling: Never drop, strike or crack it. Wear eye protection and gloves.

harmful.name: Leaded glass and phosphor dust
harmful.risk: Lead and other toxic dust if the glass breaks or is crushed.
harmful.handling: Never smash or crush. Keep intact and hand over to a certified CRT recycler.

harmful.name: High-voltage stored charge
harmful.risk: Capacitors and the tube anode can hold a dangerous charge even when unplugged.
harmful.handling: Do not open the casing unless you are trained to discharge it safely.

harmful.name: Leaded solder and flame-retardant plastics
harmful.risk: Toxic if burned or ground.
harmful.handling: Do not burn. Send boards and plastics to certified recyclers.

battery_liion.composition: Lithium metal-oxide cathode, graphite anode, flammable liquid electrolyte, metal or foil pouch casing.
battery_liion.verify_hint: Look at the pack from the side: any bulge means treat it as swollen and unstable.

reusable.name: Metal casing / current collectors
reusable.note: Aluminium and copper foils can be recovered.

reusable.name: Cobalt, nickel, lithium
reusable.note: Recoverable through specialised battery recycling.

harmful.name: Flammable electrolyte
harmful.risk: Can ignite if the cell is punctured, overheated, bent or short-circuited.
harmful.handling: Never puncture or crush. Tape terminals, keep away from metal objects and heat.

harmful.name: Heavy metals (cobalt, nickel)
harmful.risk: Toxic if burned or disposed of improperly.
harmful.handling: Never incinerate. Use certified battery / e-waste collection.

harmful.name: Hidden swelling
harmful.risk: A bulging pack can look normal from one angle.
harmful.handling: Before handling, look at the pack from the side and check whether it sits flat on a table.

battery_alkaline.composition: If alkaline: zinc anode, manganese dioxide cathode, potassium hydroxide electrolyte, steel casing. The camera cannot tell chemistry from shape: rechargeable lithium-ion cylinders look similar and are far more hazardous.
battery_alkaline.verify_hint: Read the label: if it says Li-ion, rechargeable or 3.7V, treat it as lithium-ion.

reusable.name: Steel casing
reusable.note: Recyclable as scrap steel.

reusable.name: Zinc / manganese
reusable.note: Recoverable through some battery recycling streams.

harmful.name: Chemistry NOT confirmed by the camera
harmful.risk: A rechargeable Li-ion cylinder can look like an AA/AAA cell but can ignite if punctured, crushed or shorted.
harmful.handling: Read the label first. If it says Li-ion, rechargeable, 3.6V/3.7V/4.2V or shows a high mAh value, treat it as a lithium-ion cell.

harmful.name: Potassium hydroxide electrolyte
harmful.risk: Corrosive if the casing leaks; irritates skin and eyes.
harmful.handling: Avoid puncturing. Wash hands after handling a leaking cell.

harmful.name: Trace heavy metals (older units)
harmful.risk: Minor contamination risk if landfilled in bulk.
harmful.handling: Prefer a battery collection point over regular trash.

flat_panel_monitor.composition: LCD or LED panel (glass layers, liquid crystal, polarising films), backlight (CCFL tubes in older units, LEDs in newer ones), driver and power-supply circuit boards with capacitors, plastic housing with flame retardants, metal frame and cables.
flat_panel_monitor.verify_hint: If the unit is deep and bulky with curved glass, treat it as a CRT instead.

reusable.name: Metal frame and stand
reusable.note: Steel and aluminium are recyclable.

reusable.name: Power-supply board and cables
reusable.note: Often reusable as spares; copper is recoverable.

reusable.name: Panel (if intact)
reusable.note: Can be refurbished or reused in repair markets.

harmful.name: Mercury backlight (older CCFL-lit screens)
harmful.risk: Mercury vapour if the lamp tubes break.
harmful.handling: Do not crush or break the panel. Treat older LCDs as hazardous waste.

harmful.name: Leaded solder and capacitors
harmful.risk: Lead exposure if burned or ground; capacitors can hold a charge.
harmful.handling: Do not burn or grind. Wear gloves and recycle boards through certified channels.

harmful.name: Broken glass
harmful.risk: Cracked panels can cut and release internal materials.
harmful.handling: Wear gloves and eye protection; never handle cracked panels bare-handed.
